title: Caesars Salad Dressing
ingredients: 1 tablespoon lemon juice, or more to taste
1 head romaine lettuce, torn into bite-size pieces
steps: Mince 3 cloves of garlic; transfer to a medium bowl. Add mayonnaise, 2 tablespoons grated Parmesan cheese, anchovies, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, and mustard; mix until well combined. Whisk in 1/2 pint heavy whipped cream until smooth. If needed, whisk in a splash of water, lemon juice, or olive oil to thin the dressing to the desired consistency. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Refrigerate until ready to use.

Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Quarter remaining 3 cloves garlic; add to skillet and cook until browned. Remove and discard garlic. Add bread cubes to the skillet. Cook, turning frequently, until lightly toasted and crisp; transfer to a plate and season with salt and pepper.
Place lettuce in a large bowl. Add dressing, remaining 4 tablespoons grated Parmesan cheese, and toasted bread cubes; toss to coat.
